data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2019. While a net improvement of GBP 1.0m was noted for claims reserves established at the prior year end, this was driven by favourable developments on Property, Aviation, and Marine classes, partially offset by unfavourable developments across other classes. Due to a significant reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction for the 2017 year of account, a precise gross prior year development figure cannot be isolated from the available information.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: A significant reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction occurred in 2019 for the 2017 year of account, transferring liabilities out of the syndicate. This transfer distorts the overall movement in claims provisions, making it impossible to isolate the organic gross prior year development from the RITC impact. The only explicit prior year development figure found is a net amount, which is excluded as per instructions. The claims development table is for a single year of account and is also affected by the RITC, thus not suitable for calculating aggregate prior year development.
